_comment: Power limits for every commanded move (all backends): speed in ticks/s, acc in Feetech ramp units (1 = 100 ticks/s^2). Keeps simultaneous accelerations of all 16 servos from sagging the 3S pack below the low-voltage cutoff. Higher values in a demo step are clamped and logged. stagger_ms: pause between the individual servos of one simultaneous start (16 servos x 40 ms = 0.6 s spread) so the inrush currents do not add up.
